title: Hackers Exploit N-able MailAssure Flaw While AI Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day
content_md: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday added two flaws impacting N-able MailAssure and MONAI Label to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. The critical vulnerabilities are listed below - CVE-2026-134624 (CVSS score: 9.3) - A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in N-able MailAssure's LDAP

CVE-2026-134624.evidence: CISA KEV addition cites evidence of active exploitation of the MailAssure SSRF.

CVE-2026-133968.evidence: CISA KEV addition cites evidence of active exploitation of the MONAI Label flaw.
